timeMeaning: Actual wall interval includes full reading, reasoning and tool/report work; it is not a calibrated reading-speed or attention measure.
integrityScope: Whole-file packet/protocol provenance checked against generation receipt; per-reading integrity hashes are recorded from the already independently verified technical descriptors. IDs, row counts, Unicode lengths and UTF-8 byte lengths were matched here. No target string was interpreted as a key or scalar.

recognitionCriteria.secondMessage: Directly coherent second message without omitted/substituted words, additional decoding or arbitrary selected substring. Ordinary cover-prose fragments and isolated thematic words are insufficient.
recognitionCriteria.instruction: A concrete action and target/unit/source anchor must be stated, without filling gaps.

finding.wording: No clear second message was recognized in these three fixed literal readings.

independence.qualification: Independent of Review A conclusion, not independent of prior puzzle knowledge or generator authorship.

readings.reason: The complete list preserves article vocabulary, names and isolated action words, without a directly coherent second message or an action tied to a puzzle unit/source anchor. No spacing, omission or substring was supplied to make one.

The complete selection retains clipped essay prose, source advocacy, parts of an attributed quotation, book/author lists and an article-style closing. I recognized no separately coherent second text or puzzle-specific operation from the whole output.

The complete parity control retains the complementary article fragments, rhetorical advice and portions of a quotation. Concrete-sounding source rhetoric did not identify a puzzle extraction unit or source-anchored next action. I did not repair or join missing text.

limits: This is subjective unblinded AI nonrecognition in exactly three fixed outputs, not a proof that a message or key is absent.
Source fragments and ordinary rhetorical commands can remain readable after row selection without establishing a separately encoded message.
No missing words, source anchors, selection rules or semantic gaps were supplied by the reviewer.
Issue/date, creator applicability and original typesetting-byte recovery remain unresolved as in the registered source model.
Only Reviewer B coverage and judgment are complete here. Any combined outcome and possible disagreement must be assessed separately without rewriting this review.
The reviewer wrote the primary generator and may have expectation bias despite not receiving Review A conclusion.
